Ice Nations#000.src: Talk to Adigard on the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Ice Nations#001.src: Welcome traveler, to our humble island...
Ice Nations#001.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#002.src: My people and I landed here many years ago. Unfortunately, our ship didn't make it...
Ice Nations#002.dst: Мы с моим народом высадились здесь много лет назад. Увы, наш корабль не уцелел...
Ice Nations#002.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#003.src: We tried to build a nation on these islands but became divided through the years.
Ice Nations#003.dst: Мы пытались построить на этих островах державу, но за годы раскололись.
Ice Nations#003.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#004.src: Because of this, we are fighting a useless war with our neighbours.
Ice Nations#004.dst: Потому мы и ведём бессмысленную войну с соседями.
Ice Nations#004.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#005.src: I believe we should try to pass a peace treaty, but I am afraid of getting killed if I leave the island...
Ice Nations#005.dst: Я думаю, надо заключить мир, но боюсь, что меня убьют, если я покину остров...
Ice Nations#005.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#006.src: Would you mind helping us? Talk to Hallfred about this treaty. He lives on another ice island nearby.
Ice Nations#006.dst: Поможешь нам? Поговори с Hallfred о договоре. Он живёт на соседнем ледяном острове.
Ice Nations#006.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#007.src: Talk to Hallfred about the peace treaty
Ice Nations#007.dst: Поговори с Hallfred о мирном договоре

Ice Nations#008.src: Welcome traveler! What brings you to our island?
Ice Nations#008.dst: Добро пожаловать, путник! Что привело тебя на наш остров?
Ice Nations#008.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#009.src: Oh, I see that Adigard now sends strangers through his cowardice! Worried he'll get killed?
Ice Nations#009.dst: О, вижу, Adigard из трусости уже шлёт чужаков! Боится, что его убьют?
Ice Nations#009.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#010.src: This is the last time I'll repeat it: We will sign the peace treaty the day Adigard and his nation will return to us... the treasure.
Ice Nations#010.dst: Повторяю в последний раз: мы подпишем мир в тот день, когда Adigard и его народ вернут нам... сокровище.
Ice Nations#010.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#011.src: The one that they kept and hid from us after the shipwreck.
Ice Nations#011.dst: То, что они утаили от нас после крушения.
Ice Nations#011.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#012.src: Pure gold, very valuable and rare! Tell him I'll be waiting for it. And none of that silly story again.
Ice Nations#012.dst: Чистое золото, ценное и редкое! Передай, что я жду. И никаких больше глупых баек.
Ice Nations#012.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#013.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response

Ice Nations#014.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#014.dst: Следовало ожидать. Hallfred всегда был жаден...
Ice Nations#014.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#015.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#015.dst: Мы пытались объяснить ему, что сокровища у нас нет, но без толку.
Ice Nations#015.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#016.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#016.dst: ...Видишь ли, кораблекрушение было не случайным. На нас напали...
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#017.dst: Кто? Нежить. Призраки и демоны на чудовищном корабле. Застали нас врасплох.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#018.dst: Думаю, сокровище они тоже украли тогда.
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#019.dst: Поможешь нашему народу вновь объединиться? Найди этот корабль и отнеси сокровище Hallfred, чтобы мы наконец жили в мире.
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#020.dst: Плыви на север. Там они напали на нас много лет назад. Найти несложно — уверен, они там гордо стоят на якоре... Спасибо.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred
Ice Nations#021.dst: Найди корабль-призрак и отнеси [Ancient Treasure] Hallfred

Ice Nations#022.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#022.dst: Невероятно! Он и правда отдал сокровище!
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#023.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#023.dst: Значит, войне между нашими народами конец!
Ice Nations#023.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#024.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#024.dst: Великий день! Вот, возьми награду за помощь нашему народу.
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#025.dst: Уверен, этот шлем тебе однажды пригодится!
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred
